# Agentic coding tool (Anthropic)

Anthropic calls Claude Code, the product you work with, an "agentic coding tool" ([overview][a2]): an [agent][industry.agent] for coding, and so narrower than the industry's term. In the same documentation Anthropic calls Claude Code the [harness][anthropic.agentic-harness], so the word for the agent is read by context, as the [Claude Code][anthropic.claude-code] card shows.
